title: CaseState
description: Orchestration state for ONE client case across the 8-skill insurance pipeline (V2 Phase 7). CaseState is the single source of truth: every stage reads its inputs from `artifacts` and writes exactly one artifact back. It records stage status, provenance of each artifact, and an append-only event log. It contains NO business judgment.

case_id.description: Stable identifier for the client case.

workflow.description: Workflow id this case is being run against (e.g. insurance-analysis).

stage_order.description: Canonical linear stage order. Derived from the workflow definition, never hand-edited.

current_stage.description: Last stage entered (or null before the first stage runs).

stages.description: Per-stage bookkeeping keyed by canonical skill id.

artifacts.description: Canonical artifacts keyed by artifact_type. A stage writes only its own declared artifact.

services.description: Non-linear shared services (e.g. knowledge-search Evidence Provider) keyed by skill id.

provided_by.description: When executor=provided: how the artifact entered the case (e.g. upstream-dialogue).

artifact_fingerprint.description: sha256 of the produced canonical artifact; used to detect post-hoc mutation.

type.description: STAGE_START | STAGE_COMPLETED | STAGE_NEEDS_REVIEW | STAGE_FAILED | STAGE_SKIPPED | ARTIFACT_STORED | SERVICE_CALLED | APPROVED | GUARD_REJECTED | CASE_CREATED
